statement: Chara Dasha is the Jaimini school's sign-based (not planet-based) timing technique — each of the 12 signs rules a period of 1 to 12 years, its length set by counting from the sign to wherever its own ruling planet currently sits. Read alongside Vimshottari Dasha for a second, structurally different timing perspective, since it tracks houses/life-areas through the sign period rather than planetary periods directly.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
